en: Colorized postcard showing a grand corner hotel building with a domed turret and ornate Neo‑Romanian/Secession facades, small balconies, and shops at street level. A large rooftop sign reads "ECONOMISITI LA CEC." People stroll in a central square in front of the building. The reverse has Romanian text, a 40 Bani Posta Romana stamp, and a printed caption naming Craiova and the hotel.
